description: This map displays an unexploited peat bog area, likely in Western Scotland (United Kingdom) based on surrounding document context, overlaid with a Natura 2000 habitat classification. The background is satellite imagery, possibly in false colour, showing a large central area of light pinkish-grey land cover interpreted as a bog, bordered by green vegetation and dark blue water bodies. Red outlines (polygons) are superimposed on the imagery, delineating specific areas. A white text box in the upper left corner explicitly labels these outlined areas as "Natura 2000: Active raised bogs (7110)". The map shows a large, irregularly shaped central bog outlined in red, indicating a significant active raised bog habitat. Several smaller, fragmented red outlines are visible around the periphery of this main bog and adjacent to the water, suggesting additional or contiguous peat-producing wetland areas. No scale bar, compass, or reference year is visible on the map.
